parsed.explanation: The dossier's dominant feature is an active felony sodomy regime (14/7/5 years) whose reach over a trans visitor depends on police classification — officers reading her as male brings her within scope. That classification-at-charge/custody question is unresolved, not documented safe. Enforcement is documented absent only through 2013; no later prosecution data exists, so the present is unknown, not proven dead-letter. No gender-identity or gender-expression protection appears anywhere. Border screening, custody placement, strip-search practice, and facility access for trans visitors are all explicitly uncovered. Traditional customs perpetuate religious/social discrimination; the 2023 constitutional amendment restricting marriage signals a restrictive trajectory. Positives: no prosecutions of consenting adults on record, no documented government abuses, no hate-crime or raid pattern, a UN SOGI-rights statement signature, and partial (resident-facing) employment protection. Absence of a documented universal facility ban or organised targeting keeps this out of the higher-exposure tiers, but criminalisation-by-classification plus thin recourse and major documentation gaps place it in Elevated Risk.
